task: Countdown Prelaunch Page (F011/SCR009): public /prelaunch screen counting down to EVENT_START_AT, plus a site-wide navigation lock gated on PRELAUNCH_LOCK_ENABLED that redirects every page route to /prelaunch until the event starts.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /prelaunch returns 200 and renders exactly one role=timer with 3 tiles labelled DAYS, HOURS, MINUTES
Each tile renders a 2-digit zero-padded value; negative or out-of-range clamps to 00
Title renders from next-intl: vi 'Su kien se bat dau sau', en 'Event starts in'
Absent or malformed EVENT_START_AT degrades to 00/00/00 and never throws
With PRELAUNCH_LOCK_ENABLED true and the event not reached, every page route redirects to /prelaunch
Exempt from the lock: /prelaunch, /auth/*, /api/*, /_next/* and static files
Once the event is reached the lock lifts and /prelaunch redirects to /
BR-005: a request outside the original 6-route proxy whitelist must not reach Supabase or touch cookies
The 6 pre-existing proxy routes keep their prior auth behaviour when the lock is off
No regression in the existing e2e suite after widening config.matcher
blastRadius: src/proxy.ts is the highest-blast-radius file in the repo: config.matcher widened from a literal 6-route whitelist to a negative lookahead, so the proxy now runs on nearly every request including routes it never saw (/kudos). Server Action POSTs route through it too. The three promoted countdown modules are also consumed by the homepage.
contracts: ProxyPlan / planProxy / isPrelaunchLockEnabled signature fixed by plan.md Integration contract
DOM contract for /prelaunch asserted by tests/e2e/prelaunch.spec.ts
config.matcher must stay a statically-analysable literal (Next cannot evaluate an imported constant)
messages/vi.json and messages/en.json must carry identical key sets (messages-parity test)
